text.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ حمٓ

translations.asad: Ha. Mim.
translations.sahih: Ha, Meem.

text.arabic: وَٱلْكِتَٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ

translations.asad: CONSIDER this divine writ, clear in itself and clearly showing the truth!
translations.sahih: By the clear Book,

text.arabic: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةٍۢ مُّبَٰرَكَةٍ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ

translations.asad: Behold, from on high have We bestowed it on a blessed night: for, verily, We have always been warning [man].
translations.sahih: Indeed, We sent it down during a blessed night. Indeed, We were to warn [mankind].

text.arabic: فِيهَا يُفْرَقُ كُلُّ أَمْرٍ حَكِيمٍ

translations.asad: On that [night] was made clear, in wisdom, the distinction between all things [good and evil]
translations.sahih: On that night is made distinct every precise matter -

text.arabic: أَمْرًۭا مِّنْ عِندِنَآ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِينَ

translations.asad: at a behest from Ourselves: for, verily, We have always been sending [Our messages of guidance]
translations.sahih: [Every] matter [proceeding] from Us. Indeed, We were to send [a messenger]

text.arabic: رَحْمَةًۭ مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ

translations.asad: in pur­suance of thy Sustainer’s grace [unto man]. Verily, He alone is all-hearing, all-knowing,
translations.sahih: As mercy from your Lord. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.

text.arabic: رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ

translations.asad: the Sustainer of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them - if you could but grasp it with inner certainty!
translations.sahih: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them, if you would be certain.

text.arabic: لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ ۖ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

translations.asad: There is no deity save Him: He grants life and deals death: He is your Sustainer as well as the Sustainer of your forebears of old.
translations.sahih: There is no deity except Him; He gives life and causes death. [He is] your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers.

text.arabic: بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّۢ يَلْعَبُونَ

translations.asad: Nay, but they [who lack inner certainty] are but Dying with their doubts.
translations.sahih: But they are in doubt, amusing themselves.

text.arabic: فَٱرْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَأْتِى ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ

translations.asad: WAIT, THEN, for the Day when the skies shall bring forth a pall of smoke which will make obvious [the approach of the Last Hour],
translations.sahih: Then watch for the Day when the sky will bring a visible smoke.

text.arabic: يَغْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ ۖ هَٰذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ

translations.asad: enveloping all mankind, [and causing the sinners to exclaim:] “Grievous is this suffering!
translations.sahih: Covering the people; this is a painful torment.

text.arabic: رَّبَّنَا ٱكْشِفْ عَنَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤْمِنُونَ

translations.asad: O our Sustainer, relieve us of suffering, for, verily, we [now] believe [in Thee]!”
translations.sahih: [They will say], "Our Lord, remove from us the torment; indeed, we are believers."

text.arabic: أَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ وَقَدْ جَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ

translations.asad: [But] how shall this remembrance avail them [at the Last Hour], seeing that an apostle had pre­viously come unto them, clearly expounding the truth,
translations.sahih: How will there be for them a reminder [at that time]? And there had come to them a clear Messenger.

text.arabic: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ وَقَالُوا۟ مُعَلَّمٌۭ مَّجْنُونٌ

translations.asad: whereupon they turned their backs on him and said, “Taught [by others] is he, a madman”?
translations.sahih: Then they turned away from him and said, "[He was] taught [and is] a madman."

text.arabic: إِنَّا كَاشِفُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابِ قَلِيلًا ۚ إِنَّكُمْ عَآئِدُونَ

translations.asad: [Still,] behold, We shall postpone this suffer­ing for a little while, although you are bound to revert [to your evil ways: but]
translations.sahih: Indeed, We will remove the torment for a little. Indeed, you [disbelievers] will return [to disbelief].

text.arabic: يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ ٱلْبَطْشَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ إِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ

translations.asad: on the Day when We shall seize [all sinners] with a most mighty onslaught, We shall, verily, inflict Our retribution [on you as well]!
translations.sahih: The Day We will strike with the greatest assault, indeed, We will take retribution.

text.arabic: ۞ وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَجَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌۭ كَرِيمٌ

translations.asad: AND, INDEED, [long] before their time did We try Pharaoh’s people [in the same way]: for there came unto them a noble apostle, [who said:]
translations.sahih: And We had already tried before them the people of Pharaoh, and there came to them a noble messenger,

text.arabic: أَنْ أَدُّوٓا۟ إِلَىَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌۭ

translations.asad: “Give in unto me, O God’s bondmen! Verily, I am an apostle [sent] unto you, worthy of trust!
translations.sahih: [Saying], "Render to me the servants of Allah. Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger,"

text.arabic: وَأَن لَّا تَعْلُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم بِسُلْطَٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ

translations.asad: “And exalt not yourselves against God: for, verily, I come unto you with a manifest authority [from Him];
translations.sahih: And [saying], "Be not haughty with Allah. Indeed, I have come to you with clear authority.

text.arabic: وَإِنِّى عُذْتُ بِرَبِّى وَرَبِّكُمْ أَن تَرْجُمُونِ

translations.asad: and, behold, it is with my Sustainer - and your Sustainer - that I seek refuge against all your endeavours to revile me.
translations.sahih: And indeed, I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord, lest you stone me.

text.arabic: وَإِن لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ لِى فَٱعْتَزِلُونِ

translations.asad: And if you do not believe me, [at least] stand away from me!”
translations.sahih: But if you do not believe me, then leave me alone."

text.arabic: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمٌۭ مُّجْرِمُونَ

translations.asad: But then, [when they beset him with their enmity,] he called out to his Sustainer, “These are [indeed] people lost in sin!”
translations.sahih: And [finally] he called to his Lord that these were a criminal people.

text.arabic: فَأَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى لَيْلًا إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ

translations.asad: And [God said]: “Go thou forth with My servants by night, for you will surely be pursued;
translations.sahih: [Allah said], "Then set out with My servants by night. Indeed, you are to be pursued.

text.arabic: وَٱتْرُكِ ٱلْبَحْرَ رَهْوًا ۖ إِنَّهُمْ جُندٌۭ مُّغْرَقُونَ

translations.asad: and leave the sea becalmed [between thee and Pharaoh’s men]: for, verily, they are a host destined to be drowned!”
translations.sahih: And leave the sea in stillness. Indeed, they are an army to be drowned."

text.arabic: كَمْ تَرَكُوا۟ مِن جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍۢ

translations.asad: [And so they perished: and] how many gardens did they leave behind, and water-runnels,
translations.sahih: How much they left behind of gardens and springs

text.arabic: وَزُرُوعٍۢ وَمَقَامٍۢ كَرِيمٍۢ

translations.asad: and fields of grain, and noble dwellings,
translations.sahih: And crops and noble sites

text.arabic: وَنَعْمَةٍۢ كَانُوا۟ فِيهَا فَٰكِهِينَ

translations.asad: and [all that] life of ease in which they used to delight!
translations.sahih: And comfort wherein they were amused.

text.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَأَوْرَثْنَٰهَا قَوْمًا ءَاخَرِينَ

translations.asad: Thus it was. And [then] We made another people heirs [to what they had left],
translations.sahih: Thus. And We caused to inherit it another people.

text.arabic: فَمَا بَكَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنظَرِينَ

translations.asad: and neither sky nor earth shed tears over them, nor were they allowed a respite.
translations.sahih: And the heaven and earth wept not for them, nor were they reprieved.

text.arabic: وَلَقَدْ نَجَّيْنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ

translations.asad: And, indeed, We delivered the children of Israel from the shameful suffering
translations.sahih: And We certainly saved the Children of Israel from the humiliating torment -

text.arabic: مِن فِرْعَوْنَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَالِيًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ

translations.asad: [inflicted on them] by Pharaoh, seeing that he was truly outstand­ing among those who waste their own selves;
translations.sahih: From Pharaoh. Indeed, he was a haughty one among the transgressors.

text.arabic: وَلَقَدِ ٱخْتَرْنَٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ عَلَى ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

translations.asad: and indeed, We chose them knowingly above all other people,
translations.sahih: And We certainly chose them by knowledge over [all] the worlds.

text.arabic: وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلْءَايَٰتِ مَا فِيهِ بَلَٰٓؤٌۭا۟ مُّبِينٌ

translations.asad: and gave them such signs [of Our grace] as would clearly presage a test.
translations.sahih: And We gave them of signs that in which there was a clear trial.

text.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَيَقُولُونَ

translations.asad: [Now,] behold, these [people] say indeed:
translations.sahih: Indeed, these [disbelievers] are saying,

text.arabic: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا مَوْتَتُنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُنشَرِينَ

translations.asad: “That [which is ahead of us] is but our first [and only] death, and we shall not be raised to life again.
translations.sahih: "There is not but our first death, and we will not be resurrected.

text.arabic: فَأْتُوا۟ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ

translations.asad: So then, bring forth our forefathers [as witnesses], if what you claim is true!”
translations.sahih: Then bring [back] our forefathers, if you should be truthful."

text.arabic: أَهُمْ خَيْرٌ أَمْ قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍۢ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ أَهْلَكْنَٰهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ مُجْرِمِينَ

translations.asad: Are they, then, better than the people of Tubba and those before them, whom We destroyed because they were truly lost in [the same] sin?
translations.sahih: Are they better or the people of Tubba' and those before them? We destroyed them, [for] indeed, they were criminals.

text.arabic: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَٰعِبِينَ

translations.asad: For [thus it is:] We have not created the heavens and the earth and all that is between them in mere idle play:
translations.sahih: And We did not create the heavens and earth and that between them in play.

text.arabic: مَا خَلَقْنَٰهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

translations.asad: none of this have We created without [an inner] truth: but most of them under­stand it not.
translations.sahih: We did not create them except in truth, but most of them do not know.

text.arabic: إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ مِيقَٰتُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

translations.asad: VERILY, the Day of Distinction [between the true and the false] is the term appointed for all of them:
translations.sahih: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is the appointed time for them all -

text.arabic: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى مَوْلًى عَن مَّوْلًۭى شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ

translations.asad: the Day when no friend shall be of the least avail to his friend, and when none shall be succoured
translations.sahih: The Day when no relation will avail a relation at all, nor will they be helped -

text.arabic: إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

translations.asad: save those upon whom God will have bestowed His grace and mercy: for, verily, He alone is almighty, a dispenser of grace.
translations.sahih: Except those [believers] on whom Allah has mercy. Indeed, He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

text.arabic: إِنَّ شَجَرَتَ ٱلزَّقُّومِ

translations.asad: Verily, [in the life to come] the tree of deadly fruit
translations.sahih: Indeed, the tree of zaqqum

text.arabic: طَعَامُ ٱلْأَثِيمِ

translations.asad: will be the food of the sinful:
translations.sahih: Is food for the sinful.

text.arabic: كَٱلْمُهْلِ يَغْلِى فِى ٱلْبُطُونِ

translations.asad: like molten lead will it boil in the belly,
translations.sahih: Like murky oil, it boils within bellies

text.arabic: كَغَلْىِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ

translations.asad: like the boiling of burning despair.
translations.sahih: Like the boiling of scalding water.

text.arabic: خُذُوهُ فَٱعْتِلُوهُ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ

translations.asad: [And the word will be spoken:] “Seize him, [O you forces of hell,] and drag him into the midst of the blazing fire:
translations.sahih: [It will be commanded], "Seize him and drag him into the midst of the Hellfire,

text.arabic: ثُمَّ صُبُّوا۟ فَوْقَ رَأْسِهِۦ مِنْ عَذَابِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ

translations.asad: then pour over his head the anguish of burning despair!
translations.sahih: Then pour over his head from the torment of scalding water."

text.arabic: ذُقْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْكَرِيمُ

translations.asad: Taste it - thou who [on earth] hast considered thyself so mighty, so noble!
translations.sahih: [It will be said], "Taste! Indeed, you are the honored, the noble!

text.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَمْتَرُونَ

translations.asad: This is the very thing which you [deniers of the truth] were wont to call in question!”
translations.sahih: Indeed, this is what you used to dispute."

text.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى مَقَامٍ أَمِينٍۢ

translations.asad: [As against this -] verily, the God-conscious will find themselves in a state secure,
translations.sahih: Indeed, the righteous will be in a secure place;

text.arabic: فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍۢ

translations.asad: amid gardens and springs,
translations.sahih: Within gardens and springs,

text.arabic: يَلْبَسُونَ مِن سُندُسٍۢ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٍۢ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ

translations.asad: wearing [garments] of silk and brocade, facing one another [in love].
translations.sahih: Wearing [garments of] fine silk and brocade, facing each other.

text.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ وَزَوَّجْنَٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍۢ

translations.asad: Thus shall it be. And We shall pair them with companions pure, most beautiful of eye.
translations.sahih: Thus. And We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.

text.arabic: يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِكُلِّ فَٰكِهَةٍ ءَامِنِينَ

translations.asad: In that [paradise] they shall [rightfully] claim all the fruits [of their past deeds], resting in security;
translations.sahih: They will call therein for every [kind of] fruit - safe and secure.

text.arabic: لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا ٱلْمَوْتَ إِلَّا ٱلْمَوْتَةَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ ۖ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ

translations.asad: and neither shall they taste death there after having passed through their erstwhile death. Thus will He have preserved them from all suffer­ing through the blazing fire-
translations.sahih: They will not taste death therein except the first death, and He will have protected them from the punishment of Hellfire

text.arabic: فَضْلًۭا مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ

translations.asad: an act of thy Sustainer’s favour: and that, that will be the triumph supreme!
translations.sahih: As bounty from your Lord. That is what is the great attainment.

text.arabic: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ

translations.asad: THUS, THEN, [O Prophet,] have We made this [divine writ] easy to understand, in thine own [human] tongue, so that men might take it to heart.
translations.sahih: And indeed, We have eased the Qur'an in your tongue that they might be reminded.

text.arabic: فَٱرْتَقِبْ إِنَّهُم مُّرْتَقِبُونَ

translations.asad: So wait thou [for what the future will bring]: behold, they, too, are waiting.
translations.sahih: So watch, [O Muhammad]; indeed, they are watching [for your end].
